name: io.github.clockblocker/typeprobe
title: typeprobe
description: TypeScript inferred types, completions and type errors for AI coding agents

environmentVariables.name: TYPEPROBE_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Backend for the hover and diagnostics tools. Use typescript6 if the native TypeScript 7 backend fails in your project.

environmentVariables.name: TYPEPROBE_COMPILER
environmentVariables.description: Which TypeScript compilers to use: typeprobe's bundled ones, the project's own (typescript 5.0 to 6.x; typescript 7 or @typescript/native-preview), or auto: the project's when supported, else bundled.
